dialogues.speaker: alex
dialogues.text: My friend said, maybe next year. So I made a different plan.

dialogues.speaker: alex
dialogues.text: I still wanted the trip. I just needed people who wanted it too.

dialogues.speaker: alex
dialogues.text: In Tips to Trip, open Travel Buddy. Add your route, dates and itinerary, choose your preferences, then publish your post.

dialogues.speaker: alex
dialogues.text: Open a trip post. Tap share, then choose where to send it. Bring a friend into the plan.

dialogues.speaker: alex
dialogues.text: Once your group is together, use the trip chat for the details. Tickets, meet-up times, and who's bringing what.

dialogues.speaker: alex
dialogues.text: A real plan. People who want to go. Less time waiting for everyone's calendar.

dialogues.speaker: alex
dialogues.text: Send this to your maybe next year friend. Start your Travel Buddy post on Tips to Trip.
